name: PDF Product Vouchers – Gift Vouchers – Coupons for WooCommerce + Drag And Drop Template Builder
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
PDF Product Vouchers – Gift Vouchers – Coupons for WooCommerce is a robust plugin designed to create and sell highly customizable PDF vouchers, perfect for online and brick-and-mortar stores. It enables businesses to craft personalized gift vouchers, event tickets, discount coupons, or promotional codes with seamless WooCommerce integration. The plugin’s drag and drop builder template simplifies the creation of professional, branded vouchers, while the PDF Coupons functionality enhances its versatility by offering advanced coupon management and customization options.

Drag and Drop Builder Template

  • Intuitive “What You See Is What You Get” Interface: The drag and drop editor allows users to design vouchers without coding expertise. Easily place elements like product names, prices, recipient details, or personalized messages directly onto the template.

  • Flexible Customization: Add, reposition, or modify elements such as text, images, QR codes, or barcodes to align with your brand or specific occasions like holidays or special events.

  • Custom Background Image Support: Choose from 6 default backgrounds or upload custom images to create unique voucher designs. Customers can select alternate backgrounds during purchase for added personalization.

  • Dynamic Data Field Integration: Incorporate dynamic fields like SKU, price, or customer information into the voucher template via the drag and drop editor for accuracy and professionalism.

  • Multilingual and Custom Font Support: Add text in multiple languages and customize fonts (including Google Fonts or uploaded fonts) to suit your brand or localization requirements.

  • Customizable Voucher Size and Layout: Adjust voucher dimensions (e.g., A4, Letter, or custom sizes) directly in the drag and drop interface for compatibility with print or digital formats.

  • Advanced Dynamic Elements: Include dynamic fields like expiration dates, unique promo codes, or store details (e.g., address, logo, contact) to enhance voucher functionality.

  • Save and Reuse Templates: Store designed templates for reuse in future campaigns, streamlining the process for creating similar vouchers with minor adjustments.

  • Integration with External Design Tools: Import designs from tools like Adobe Illustrator or Canva into the drag and drop editor for further refinement, ensuring brand consistency.

  • Real-Time Preview: Instantly preview voucher designs during the creation process to ensure the layout and aesthetics meet your standards before finalizing.

PDF Coupons

  • Customizable Coupon Creation: Design PDF-based coupons with the drag and drop builder, allowing for tailored discount offers, such as percentage-based, fixed-amount, or product-specific coupons, with unique codes or barcodes for tracking.

  • Bulk Coupon Generation: Generate multiple unique PDF coupons in bulk for large-scale promotions or campaigns, with customizable fields like discount value, expiration date, or usage limits, all configured through the drag and drop interface.

  • Personalized Coupon Delivery: Automatically send PDF coupons to customers via email after purchase or allow customers to forward coupons to recipients, with options to include personalized messages or branding elements.

  • Coupon Usage Restrictions: Set specific conditions for coupon redemption, such as minimum purchase amounts, eligible products, or customer groups, directly within the drag and drop editor for precise control.

  • Dynamic Coupon Codes: Integrate dynamic coupon codes into the PDF template, ensuring each coupon is unique and trackable, with QR codes or barcodes for easy in-store or online validation.

  • Campaign Tracking and Analytics: Monitor coupon usage with detailed reports on redemption status (e.g., used, unused, expired), accessible through the WooCommerce dashboard, helping businesses evaluate campaign effectiveness.

  • Customizable Coupon Expiry Notifications: Add expiration date fields to PDF coupons via the drag and drop builder and configure automated email reminders to customers before coupons expire, encouraging timely use.

  • Integration with WooCommerce Promotions: Seamlessly combine PDF coupons with existing WooCommerce promotions, such as cart discounts or bundle offers, enhancing marketing flexibility.

PDF Vouchers

  • Smart Voucher and Coupon Code Management: Automatically generate unique voucher or coupon codes, or allow customers to input custom codes, with QR or barcode scanning for in-store or online validation.

  • WooCommerce Email Integration: Vouchers and coupons are automatically emailed to customers post-purchase, with options to send directly to gift recipients or coupon holders.

  • Support for Multiple Voucher and Coupon Types: Create gift cards, event tickets, percentage-based discounts, fixed-value coupons, or service-specific vouchers to suit various business needs.

  • Compatibility with WooCommerce Extensions: Integrates with plugins like WooCommerce Subscriptions, WooCommerce Bookings, Name Your Price, or Points and Rewards for enhanced functionality in loyalty programs or booking systems.

  • Comprehensive Tracking and Reporting: Access detailed analytics on voucher and coupon usage, including redemption rates and expiration statuses, for better business management.

The PDF Product Vouchers – Gift Vouchers for WooCommerce plugin, with its drag and drop builder template and PDF Coupons functionality, offers unparalleled flexibility and creativity. It empowers businesses to create professional, branded vouchers and coupons effortlessly, enhancing customer experience and driving sales in WooCommerce stores.

sections.installation:
Normal installation

  1. Download the woocommerce.zip file to your computer.
  2. Unzip the file.
  3. Upload the plugin.zip directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
    Document include in plugin
